description: This Java source file defines a factory class for creating SASL authenticators used in the AMQP adapter, supporting mechanisms like PLAIN and EXTERNAL, with tenant and device validation, certificate handling, and connection limiting.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticatorFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating SASL authenticators for the AMQP adapter, supporting mechanisms like PLAIN and EXTERNAL, with tenant and device validation.

classes.name: AmqpAdapterSaslAuthenticator
classes.description: Inner class managing the SASL authentication process, handling mechanism negotiation, credential verification, and connection limits.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the SASL authenticator.

methods.name: getSupportedMechanisms
methods.description: Returns the list of supported SASL mechanisms based on configured providers.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the SASL authenticator with socket, connection, and transport details.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles the SASL handshake, mechanism selection, and credential verification.

methods.name: buildSaslResponseContext
methods.description: Builds context for the SASL response based on the mechanism used.

methods.name: parseSaslResponse
methods.description: Parses the SASL response bytes into fields.

methods.name: invokePreAuthenticationHandler
methods.description: Invokes optional pre-authentication handler after receiving SASL response.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies the SASL credentials based on mechanism.

methods.name: verifyPlain
methods.description: Verifies credentials for PLAIN mechanism, including tenant and device validation.

methods.name: verifyExternal
methods.description: Verifies credentials for EXTERNAL mechanism using client certificate.

methods.name: getTenantObject
methods.description: Retrieves tenant information based on issuer DN or tenant ID.

methods.name: checkTenantIsEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the tenant has the AMQP adapter enabled.
